page.notes: The page is printed upside down, so the text runs from the bottom of the scan. The body text and the inverted block at the top are too faint and too small to read reliably, so almost all lines are marked illegible. The large initial block is an ornamental woodcut with no legible letter, and the chapter heading is upside down and unreadable. The page number "50" is read from an inverted printed number and is uncertain. The running head reads HISTORIA ARABVM. The lighter ghost text in the margins and on the right is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed.
